findings.title: Changing the recreate exit code from 4 to 3 may break existing consumers
Feature check runs without the feature being enabled at build/runtime for the commands
Doc template hard-codes the feature flag in the command, including the metadata command

false_positives.candidate: Changing RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3 may break existing consumers that hard-code the old value, causing disabled feature (4) to be misread as 'recreate' by consumers still checking for 4

Feature check is duplicated in both commands and placed before validateConfig(), unclear if Profile is initialized with --features option at this point - runtime flag may be ignored if profile is only built from persisted build-time options
picocli.exit() followed by return relies on exit code being applied later - should move check into shared base class to avoid drift

Doc template hard-codes --features=rolling-updates after ${parameters} for every macro use, which may conflict with examples that already pass --features or other options, and reads as if the flag is permanent rather than preview-only

false_negatives.golden_comment: Incorrect method call for exit codes. The picocli.exit() method calls System.exit() directly, which is problematic:
Need to add changelog/release notes documenting the exit code change and migration guidance
